mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, it is a clear night with temperatures holding steady at 61 degrees at Verona Community Park, all under a Waning Crescent moon.

The City of Verona keeps the community running through its engineering partnership with AECOM, and the Senior Center is currently offering free tri-shaw bike rides along the Military Ridge State Trail for those looking to enjoy the outdoors.

It is a busy weekend in town. Today, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company or check out the Girls Try Hockey event. Looking ahead, yoga is available tomorrow at Insight Wellness.
On Thursday, July 31, police conducted a traffic stop that led to an arrest for an O W I, with the driver also cited for driving on a flat tire and having no taillights.
Today is the perfect day for a scoop of Snickers Swirl. Since the restaurant is currently closed, you can plan your visit for when they open today at 10 AM.
